packageRules.description: Conventional Commits type: dependency updates are build. config:recommended's semantic prefix rules set fix for runtime dependencies, so a top-level semanticCommitType alone is overridden
Conventional Commits scope: workflow changes are ci
The 0.6.x-compat builds are a compatibility artifact, not newer releases

JDK 21 matches every build's toolchain and the Gradle daemon JVM, and the backend runner's Ubuntu 24.04 matches the server image's noble base and its FFmpeg 6.1, so a bump means changing those too: list it on the dashboard instead of opening a PR
Merge minor, patch and digest updates once every check on the branch's head is green. Renovate merges by itself rather than through GitHub's auto-merge, so it needs no branch protection
Kotlin, the Android Gradle plugin and Compose Multiplatform are preview pins that move together; merged by hand
AGENTS.md: track kotlinx.serialization and kotlinx.coroutines prereleases
The wrapper is pinned to a Gradle milestone; keep following prereleases

The server's own images: compose.build.yaml builds sofa-king-backend locally, and compose.yaml follows the rolling main tag, which a digest pin would freeze (and the updater cannot docker tag a digest reference)
